fusions.name: Gathered Haunches
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second wind-up, gores a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 20 damage to everything in it and tossing them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Out of the Herd
fusions.desc: Slips out from beside your allies to claw an enemy for 7 damage, plus 10% for each ally beside you (max +30%), and strips 5% of its armour for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Straw
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, the ground within 3 tiles of where you stood restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow Second Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
